observations: Three photos show the same standing fan from slightly different angles.
The fan has a black base with a spoked design, a black pole with a gold-colored joint, and a beige motor housing with a red and black logo.
The protective cage is made of thin metal wires, and the blades are visible behind it.
The brand name 'Sunbeam' is visible on the motor housing in all three photos.
The fan is standing on a brown floor against a white wall.
A TV or monitor is visible on the right side of the frame in all photos, with cables running down the wall.
The seller's text mentions 'Power Bank' but the photos show a standing fan, not a power bank.

No photo shows the fan in operation. There is no visible power cord or plug, and no indication of functionality. The fan appears clean but there is no proof it works.
